def recursive_calc(n, cache={}):
    if n in cache:
        return cache[n]
    if n <= 11:
        return min(n, 2 + (11 - n))
    pattern = 1
    level = 1
    while pattern <= n:
        pattern = pattern * 10 + 1
        level += 1
    threshold = pattern // 10
    if pattern > 2 * n:
        quotient = n // threshold
        remainder = n % threshold
        val1 = recursive_calc(pattern - n, cache) + level
        val2 = quotient * (level - 1) + recursive_calc(remainder, cache)
        cache[n] = min(val1, val2)
        return cache[n]
    else:
        quotient = n // threshold
        remainder = n % threshold
        val1 = recursive_calc(pattern - n, cache) + level
        val2 = quotient * (level - 1) + recursive_calc(remainder, cache)
        cache[n] = min(val1, val2)
        return cache[n]
